messages:
Ava (Support): Pinecrest Labs is stuck on onboarding — they completed the console flow and say a key was created, but every request returns 403. They insisted the key was created during SSO.

Ava (Support): Customer pasted curl output: 
```
$ curl -s -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-pine-xxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json

{"error":"project_access_denied","message":"Requested project 8623 is not accessible with provided key"}
```

Ava (Support): They expect traffic to go to project `pinecrest-prod` (org id `org_8623`). In the console I see a key in their workspace but the project selector on the key is blank — looks workspace-scoped.

Dylan (Platform Eng): @Ava can you share the visible key id (only id, not the secret) and confirm the project they clicked in the UI? Also — did they sign up via SSO or a direct invite?

Ava (Support): Key id is `key_7d9f2a`. Project shown in UI was `pinecrest-prod` / `org_8623`. They came in via Okta SSO; we got a SCIM provisioning event yesterday at 2026-02-10T09:12:30Z.

Raj (SRE): Let's check internal metadata for the key. Quick internal curl to token/keys service: 
```
curl -s -H "X-Internal-Auth: $TOKEN" https://internal-api.redwood/keys/key_7d9f2a
```
We want owner_project and scopes.

Dylan (Platform Eng): I ran the internal lookup, redacted result: 
```
{ "id": "key_7d9f2a", "secret_hash": "***", "owner_workspace": "pinecrest-ws", "owner_project": "pinecrest-dev", "scopes": ["inference:generate"], "created_at": "2026-02-10T09:12:45Z" }
```

Dylan (Platform Eng): That explains the 403 — the secret is bound to `pinecrest-dev` while they tried to use it against `pinecrest-prod`.

Ava (Support): Customer insists they selected prod during console onboarding. Possible cause: SSO/SCIM provisioning created the workspace and the default project mapping wasn't provided in the SCIM or SAML assertion, so the system fell back to the workspace default (`pinecrest-dev`).

eng-identity-bot: Provision event found: user_create via Okta connector at 2026-02-10T09:12:30Z. SCIM payload missing `default_project` claim — fallback applied (workspace default).

Raj (SRE): Repro steps for eng/support if needed: 
1) Create a test Okta org with same SCIM mapping.
2) Trigger SSO sign-up.
3) Check `/internal/keys/{id}` for owner_project.
4) Call API with the key — expect 403 when project mismatch.

Dylan (Platform Eng): Short-term remediation options: 
- Option A (fast, server-side): Rebind the existing key to `pinecrest-prod` via internal admin endpoint (non-destructive but changes audit trail). Example: 
```
POST /internal/keys/key_7d9f2a/rebind
{ "target_project": "pinecrest-prod" }
```
- Option B (recommended): Create a brand new key scoped to `pinecrest-prod` and have the customer rotate. Cleaner audit history.

Ava (Support): Customer wants an immediate unblock and prefers not to change their integration. Which option do we offer?

Raj (SRE): Recommend Option B — create a new key and push it to their admin in console. Offer a 24-hour overlap window to rotate. If they insist on zero action, Option A is possible but needs approval and will record an admin rebind event.

Dylan (Platform Eng): I'll create a new key bound to `pinecrest-prod` and deprecate the old one. Also opening a follow-up for eng-identity to tighten provisioning.

Dylan (Platform Eng): Internal create log: 
```
POST /internal/keys
{ "owner_project": "pinecrest-prod", "scopes": ["inference:generate"] }
=> key_ee12b4 (secret delivered to customer admin via console secure view)
```

Ava (Support): Sent the new secret to Pinecrest admin through secure console messaging. They tested and confirmed success: 
```
$ curl -s -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-pine-NEW" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json

{"id":"resp_123","tokens":45}
```

Ava (Support): Pinecrest is unblocked. They will rotate away from the old key within 24 hours. They asked for root cause and prevention steps.

Dylan (Platform Eng): Root cause: SCIM provisioning omitted `default_project` resulting in the fallback to the workspace default project. Preventative actions: 
- Update Okta/OneLogin SCIM templates and docs to include `default_project` mapping.
- Add provisioning validation to fail onboarding if `default_project` is absent (don't silently default).
- Run an audit for SSO-created workspaces in the last 30 days and fix any key bindings where project != expected.

Maya (Product): I'll own the docs update and coordinate with partner integrations. Adding this to next retro and to the partner checklist.

Ava (Support): Filing ticket SUP-2026-2187 with summary, actions, and follow-ups. Assigning to @dylan and @raj for engineering and to @product for docs.

sentry-bot: Tag applied: provisioning-mapping-gap. Issue: https://sentry.redwood/issue/PRV-4721

Raj (SRE): Adding a runbook entry for "key vs project mismatch" with sample internal queries and steps for rotation. Will push to eng-sre runbook.

Ava (Support): Customer asked to be notified when the provisioning guard is deployed. Please mention this thread or add a comment on SUP-2026-2187.

Ava (Support): Closing notes: Pinecrest confirmed rotation; keeping the support ticket open until provisioning guard is implemented. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
